company.shortDescription: Askdata is a platform that makes data interaction simple and get a frictionless Data Experience that is collaborative and fast.
company.description:
Askdata removes any boundaries between users and data.

With AskData, users ask questions in natural language and find answers across all their data. The Askdata platform is based on the Human2SQL, the biggest repository of natural language and SQL statements in the world.

The main platform features:

Superior Natural Language Querying 
Personalized Feed of Proactive Answers
Message-Driven Collaborative Workflows
